entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Seems like you can't reach a decision.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: In all honesty, I really wanted you to[n]accept my gift of your own free will...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But I see that demanding a decision[n]from you is only making you suffer.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That was never my intention—so, don't[n]worry. There's no need to obsess over it[n]anymore.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: For as many days or years as you[n]may have.
